description: This file contains decompositions for PyTorch operations related to Jacobian-vector products (JVP). It defines decorators for registering decompositions, functions for handling specific decompositions, and several implementations of backward passes for normalization layers, primarily used in automatic differentiation and custom gradient computations.

methods.description: Decorator that attempts to register a decomposition for an operator and returns the original function if registration fails.

methods.description: Decorator for registering a decomposition specific to JVP with a custom registry.

methods.name: _register_jit_decomposition_for_jvp(decomp, use_python=False)
methods.description: Function to register a decomposition with torch.jit, optionally wrapping it in Python code.

methods.description: Recomputes mean and variance of input tensor, used for normalization layers to track gradients.

methods.description: Utility function to compute the product of a list of integers.

methods.description: Decomposition for the 'trace' operation, summing the diagonal elements of a tensor.
